ios.desc:
Send Bottles, find the right people, change your life & have fun!

Bottler is a unique AI-backed social network that helps you find the right people all over the world using tags and a little bit of magic. Making new connections has never been so easy! Just add a tag to your message, type your text, and let Bottler do the rest. In a blink of an eye, here comes the change. You won't know who receives your bottle, you just send it and wait for someone to pick up your message. Trust us, it's going to be so much fun.

Find your dream job and people with similar interests, connect with celebrities and locals in your city, find love and make friends for life. Bottler can make your life brighter, easier, and better.

We understand that no app is perfect, but at Bottler, we are committed to doing our best to connect people around the world and create one big friendly community. Our goal is to make every Bottler user happier, healthier, and richer in whatever way that means to them. We believe we can achieve this with your help.

Let's make a change, let's connect together!
